sections.heading: Ingredients
items: 1 cup bean sprouts or cabbage shredded

sections.heading: Seasoning
items: 1 tsp chili sauce (if you like it hot)

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Marinate the pork in the soy sauce, wine and cornstarch.
Soak the black mushrooms, golden needles and woodears in water for at least 15 minutes until soft.
Heat 3 TBS oil in a wok. Stir-fry the eggs and then chop them into small pieces. Remove from wok and set aside.

Heat 2 TBS oil in the wok and stir-fry the meat, then remove it. Use the same oil to brown the scallion, ginger, and black mushrooms. Add the woodear, golden needle, bamboo shoots and stir for a while. Add the meat, eggs and seasoning. Stir-fry the mixture together and serve with pancake.
Steam the pancake in a steamer on low heat until soft (approx. 5 minutes). Place 2-3 TBS filling (#4) in the pancake and serve hot.

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Slowly add 1 cup boiling water to the flour using chopsticks to stir quickly. Add cold water and knead the dough thoroughly until it is smooth. Cover with a damp cloth and let it set for 15-30 minutes.

Divide the dough into 40 small pieces. Flatten each piece with your hand. Lightly oil the whole top surface with sesame oil. Lay a second pancake on top of the oiled surface, pat down a little, then roll out both layers very thin, to about 5 inch diameters.

Using an unoiled flat pan on medium heat, cook the pancake on one side until bubbles rise (about 30 seconds). Turn over and cook the second side for about 15 seconds. Remove from pan and separate the 2 rounds quickly by pulling apart very carefully. This leaves you with the 2 original layers.
Take the separated layers and cover with clean towels to keep them warm.
These may be made in advance, stacked, covered and frozen. When needed warm in a steamer until hot and then fold into quarters.

title: Chinese Style Pork Chops in Special Sauce

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Marinate the pork chops in the sauce for 1 hour.
Heat 6 cups of oil until hot. Lower the heat and deep fry the pork chops for about 10 minutes. Serve hot.

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Clean the pork and place it in cold water and bring it to a boil. After it boils, cook the pork for 25 minutes. (Add a little ginger, scallion and wine to the water for flavor).
Let the pork cool down after removing it from the water. Slice it into long thin slices and set aside.
Heat 3 TBS oil in the wok. Stir fry the pork, add the garlic, bean cake, cabbage, green pepper, and the seasoning and stir well. Add the scallion and cook momentarily.
Remove from the heat and serve hot.

sections.heading: Ingredients
items: 1 cup each of green pepper, carrot and onion

sections.heading: To Cook
items: Pound the meat and cut into 1 inch squares. Marinate in the sauce for at least 1/2 hour.
Coat the meat with dry cornstarch.
Deep fry in hot oil for 2 minutes and remove the meat from the oil to allow it to get hot again. Deep fry the pork for another minute and remove and set aside.

Heat 2 TBS oil in the wok. Stir fry the vegetables, add the sweet and sour sauce and stir the mixture until it becomes thick and bubbly. Now add the meat, stir momentarily and remove to a serving dish.

sections.heading: Ingredients
items: 2 cups leek cut into 1 1/2 inch lengths

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Cut the pork into 2 inch strips 1/2 inch thick and marinate in the sweet bean sauce for 15 minutes.
Coat the meat with the flour and deep fry for 2 minutes then set aside. When the oil is hot again then deep fry the pork for another minute.
Use 2 TBS oil in the wok to brown the garlic and leek until the flavor comes out. Add the meat and sauce mixture and cook momentarily then remove from the wok and serve hot.

title: Shredded Pork in Sweet Bean Sauce

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Marinate pork in sauce A for 15 minutes.
Heat 2 cups oil to fry the meat, drain well and set aside.
Use 1 TB oil to stir-fry sauce B until thick and shiny. Add meat and mix well til heated through. Serve on top of shredded scallion with mandarin pancakes.

sections.heading: Ingredients
items: 2 TBS cloud ear - soaked and shredded

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Marinate the meat in the marinating sauce for 10 minutes. Heat up 1 cup oil very hot and stir fry the meat then drain and set aside.
Use 3 TBS oil to brown mixture A until the oil changes to a red color. Add the water chestnuts, cloud ear, and meat. Add the meat sauce, cook for a short time, add the scallion and then serve hot.

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Cut the meat into long strips of 1 1/2 inch thickness and marinate it in a mixture of the above ingredients for 6 hours.
Preheat the oven to 450F and roast the pork for 40 to 45 minutes.
Slice the meat when it has cooled down a little.

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Use 2 TBS oil to brown the onion and garlic.
Add the pork to the pan and stir fry until the pork is fully cooked. Add all the rest of the seasonings and cook at medium heat (simmer) for more than 1 hour.
This dish should be served over hot steamed rice.

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Beat the eggs together well and add all of the ingredients.

Pour the mixture into a bowl suitable for steaming. Place the bowl in the steamer or a pot and steam for 5 minutes. Let the bowl stand in the pot for 10 additional minutes with the heat off. Serve hot.

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Cut the pork into thin slices and marinate in sauce mixture for 1/2 hour.
Cut chicken livers into quarters. Place one scallion and one piece of liver inside the pork slices and roll up. Secure with tooth pick.
Place all the rolls in a baking pan and roast at 425 for 20-30 minutes until done. Serve hot.

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Mash the pork until it becomes very fine and add all the pork seasonings. Mix thoroughly and then divide the meat into 4 large balls.
Stir fry 3/4ths of the cabbage in the wok until the cabbage becomes soft. Lay this cabbage in the bottom of the cooking pot.
Place the meat balls on top of the soft cabbage and place the rest of the cabbage over the top of the meat. Add all of the ingredients to the pot and bring it to a boil.
Lower the heat and simmer cook the pork for 3 to 4 hours. If the liquid boils away from the covered pot, you may add a little more soup stock to the pot. Serve hot.

sections.heading: Ingredients
items: 1/2 LB pork cut into thin strips
2 TBS chopped scallion to be sprinkled on the finished dish

sections.heading: To Prepare
items: Heat 3-4 TBS oil in the wok. Stir fry the meat, scallion (1/2 cup), and black mushroom. Add the soy sauce, salt, bamboo shoot, carrot, celery, and noodles and stir fry together until the noodles become brown. Be sure to continually stir the noodles to prevent them from sticking to the bottom of the wok. If desired, one could add 1-2 TBS of cooking oil.
Now add the bean sprouts, pea pods, sesame seed oil, and MSG and after stirring for a short time, remove to a serving dish.
Sprinkle the scallion over the top and serve hot.

sections.heading: Ingredients for Meat Sauce
items: 1/2 LB pork or beef (chopped into small pieces)

sections.heading: To Cook the Meat Sauce
items: Heat 3 TBS cooking oil in the wok and brown the ginger and scallion. Stir in the meat and brown together.
Add (A) mixture to the meat and stir fry for a short time. Add (B) ingredients in the order listed above.
Add the chicken broth and let simmer for about 3 minutes until the sauce becomes thick and shiny. Put the mixture into a serving bowl and set aside.

sections.heading: Prepare the Toppings (pour into individual serving bowls)
items: Boil 1/2 LB bean sprouts for 1 minute and drain.
Boil 2 TBS frozen peas for 2 minutes then let stand in water.
Cut 1 cucumber into very fine strips.
Scramble 3 eggs and 1/4 tsp salt together and fry it in the shape of a very thin pancake. Cut it into very thin strips.

Cook Chinese egg noodles in hot boiling water about 3 minutes and remove from heat. If you wish to serve the dish cold then pour off the hot water, rinse with cold water, allow to drain, then add 1 TBS sesame seed oil and mix well.

sections.heading: To Serve
items: Put about 1 cup of hot or cold noodles in a serving bowl, add some cooked bean sprouts, cucumber, 1-2 TBS of meat sauce, plus any other ingredients over the meat as taste dictates.
